name: vllm-code
description: Agentic coding panel for your vLLM server. A Claude Code / Codex–style chat experience powered by the open-source OpenCode agent, with a built-in manager for local vLLM instances, Hugging Face downloads, and LoRA adapters.

commands.title: vLLM Code: Open Chat in Editor Tab

vllmCode.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible vLLM server. Include the /v1 suffix (it is added automatically if omitted). For a remote/WSL/Docker server, use its reachable address, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8000/v1.

vllmCode.apiKey.description: Optional bearer token for a vLLM server started with --api-key. Leave empty for the default (no auth).

vllmCode.opencodePath.description: Override path to an opencode binary. Leave empty to use your own install (PATH, ~/.opencode/bin/opencode) if present, otherwise the binary bundled with this extension.

vllmCode.serverPort.description: Port for the embedded OpenCode server. 0 = pick a free port automatically.

vllmCode.defaultModel.description: Model id to select by default (must match a model your vLLM server reports at /v1/models, e.g. meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct). Empty = first available.

vllmCode.agent.description: OpenCode agent. 'build' can edit files and run tools; 'plan' is read-only.

vllmCode.minContextLength.description: Context budget OpenCode packs before compacting (and the meter denominator). vLLM's actual window is fixed at server launch via --max-model-len; this is clamped to the model's reported max when known.

vllmCode.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to launch local vLLM via `python -m vllm` when no `vllm` binary is on PATH. Leave empty to auto-detect.

vllmCode.vllmPath.description: Override path to the `vllm` executable used by the local model manager. Leave empty to auto-detect on PATH.

vllmCode.hfPath.description: Override path to the Hugging Face CLI (`hf` or `huggingface-cli`) used to download models. Leave empty to auto-detect.

vllmCode.hfToken.description: Optional Hugging Face token for downloading gated/private models. Falls back to the HF_TOKEN environment variable.

vllmCode.defaultMaxModelLen.description: Default --max-model-len pre-filled in the model manager when launching a local vLLM instance.

vllmCode.defaultGpuMemoryUtilization.description: Default --gpu-memory-utilization (0–1) pre-filled in the model manager when launching a local vLLM instance.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run check-types:test && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run check-types:test && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.test: npm run check-types:test && node esbuild.test.js && node --test "out-test/**/*.test.js"
